eldora.note: 5:36 AM update – Good morning, skiers and riders! Welcome to the Eldora snow report for Tuesday, March 31st, 2026. Happy Tuesday, everyone! Today will be another amazing spring day to come up to the mountain! Temps will be be warm, you'll have the mountain to yourself, and the vibes will be immaculate. This is the time to get those laps in and enjoy sliding on snow before it's too late. For what we have, the conditions are actually extremely fun and the snow is feeling great!. Even though it's warm, we've been getting out there every day and enjoying the snow that we have to offer. It is definitely spring, and we honestly can't get enough of it! Come on up today and try it out for yourself! Any day on snow is a great day!. NWS Weather Snapshot: A slight chance of snow showers between 9am and noon, then rain and snow showers likely. Mostly cloudy, with a high near 49. Light south wind increasing to 5 to 9 mph in the morning. Winds could gust as high as 15 mph. Chance of precipitation is 60%. Little or no snow accumulation expected. Uphill and Nordic Skiing... The Nordic Center is now closed for the season. Check Nordic Pulse for the latest update. Uphill Access is now closed for the season. Visit eldora.com/uphill for more info. 2026-27 season passes are now on sale . Lock in your lowest price now, before prices increase on April 30. Stay in the loop: This page, eldora.com/conditions , is always your go-to for the latest updates, but you can also sign up for text alerts so you never miss a beat. Text one of the following keywords to (866) 965-6224: ELDORA for general alerts, UPHILL for uphill-specific updates, or NORDIC for Nordic updates. Message and data rates may apply. Thanks for checking the Eldora snow report. We'll see you on the hill! -- GENERAL INFORMATION Lift Hours: 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM, seven days a week. Lodge Hours: 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM, seven days a week. High-Occupancy Vehicle (HOV) Parking: Per Boulder County requirements, the Elk Lot (nearest to Alpenglow chair) is reserved seven days a week for vehicles with three or more occupants on a first-come, first-served basis. Learn more here . EV Parking: Eldora provides 30 free ChargePoint EV charging stations. These premium parking spots are available on a first-come, first-served basis and are subject to the SOV policy above. To park in the EV lot, you MUST have an EV and be actively charging. If you are finished charging, please move your car to another non-EV space so others can use the chargers. Easy, Convenient RTD Bus Service from Boulder: RTD’s NB route brings you from Downtown Boulder Station straight to the Alpenglow chairlift in about 40 minutes; riders 19 and under ride RTD for FREE through RTD's Zero Fare for Youth program. For schedule and fare info, visit rtd-denver.com

killington.note: Good morning, Beast family, We can't believe it's already the final day of March, but here we are. Fortunately, there's plenty of great spring skiing and riding ahead of us, and even more good times at The Beast. As of this morning, we're holding on to 100 open trails, putting us back the top spot for most terrain in the East. After another beautiful, sunny day, the weather is shifting back to a wetter pattern. Light showers have already made their way to the mountain, and we're expecting the r*** to continue for most of the day. Temperatures will stay on the milder side, with highs reaching into the mid-40s, and a west-southwest wind running 15 to 25 mph at the base and 25 to 40 mph up top. With the warmer overnight temperatures and incoming moisture, our grooming plan has been slightly reduced to help preserve snow coverage. A number of trails will remain ungroomed, including Cascade, Wildfire, Pipe Dream, and Full House, among others. This is a strategic move as we continue to manage conditions through this stretch of spring weather. Be sure to check out the Lifts & Trails Report for the full list of groomers. Even though spring is showing us it's true colors, there is still plenty of fantastic skiing and riding to be had. Expect beautiful soft conditions throughout the day and fun on every lap. Our groomed runs including Bunny Buster, East Fall, Skyelark and others will be skiing as if you are slicing through butter this morning. Conditions will loosen up by the afternoon, where splashing around in the bumps should be all time. Coverage remains strong across the mountain, though areas of thin cover are beginning to appear as we face the incoming weather. Looking ahead, we’re getting ready for one of our signature spring events, the Bear Mountain Mogul Challenge, returning this weekend. It’s always a great time at Bear with big bumps, big energy, and plenty of action. We still have a few spots available in our women’s categories, so click here if you’re looking to throw down. Not competing? Come be part of the scene and catch all the action from the sidelines. We are scheduled to have 12 lifts spinning today, with key lifts opening at 9:00 a.m. and the North Ridge Quad opening at 9:30 a.m. Please note: Although we will be running a bonus weekend over at Skyeship this weekend, Stage I will be closed until Friday. On the kparks front, our Bear parks, Dream Maker and The Stash, are firing with a full lineup of features. Over on Ramshead, Timberline continues to shine with 44 features, 5 jumps, and a halfpipe. Our Parks Crew recently refreshed features in Timberline and gave the halfpipe a fresh cut. Easy Street, Lil’ Stash, and Vale Yard are also dialed in for fun progression options. Check the Terrain Parks Report for all the details. Embrace the r***. Be The Beast! We’ll see you out there. -Austin Operating Day: 139 Season passes for 26/27 are now on sale! Lock in the lowest price on Beast 365 or Winter Unlimited passes with lots of perks, plus free skiing & riding for the rest of this spring. Even better news for families: Youth & Child pass pricing has been significantly reduced for next season, with over $300 in savings on Beast 365 access. Lifts Key lifts operate seven days a week from 9:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. on Monday through Friday, and from 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. on Saturday and Sunday. The North Ridge Quad will open at 9:30 a.m. on weekdays and 8:00 a.m. on weekends, the Canyon Quad will spin from 10:00 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. Monday, Wednesday, Friday and 9:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. on weekends, and the Sunrise Village Triple will spin until 3:00 p.m. on weekdays and 4:00 p.m. on weekends. A note for our snowboarders: Thanks to our new cabins on the Skyeship Gondola, we're asking you to please utilize the snowboard racks outside of each cabin. If the racks are entirely full, please put your boards underneath the seats. This differs from our K-1 Gondola, where all snowboards should be brought inside the cabins. Just remember: outside Skyeship, inside K-1! The Tubing Park presented by bubly is closed for the season. copper mountain.note: Good morning from Copper Mountain! Snow lovers unite! As much as we love sunny skies and bluebird spring days, we love fresh snow even more. Today begins a return to winter with a series of storms heading our way. Expect mostly cloudy skies today with a chance for snow this afternoon and a high temperature near 40 degrees. Southwest winds will start light this morning, then ramp up midday as the storm approaches. With new snow on the way, conditions will be changing. Keep in mind that fresh coverage can hide rocks and hazards that may still be just below the surface. Stay alert, ski and ride with caution, and keep an eye out for variable terrain and conditions. Special shoutout to all the USASA athletes, coaches, families, and supporters here this week and next for the National Championship. We hope you're having a super fun time at Copper, and we're stoked to have you here!

snowbird.note: Gooooood morning Snowbird! It’s Owen, with your snow report for Tuesday. Mountain Update: 8 am - 2 pm spring lift operations will remain in place through Tuesday, March 31. Hours will return to 9 am - 4 pm starting Wednesday, April 1. This storm seems to be pushing back just bit by bit, but maybe it’ll actually pull through today, but it’s looking like it won’t be until after close today unfortunately. Maybe it just got nervous, it’s been a while, so cut a little slack. That’s alright though, just another day of spring skiing then. It may stay firm a little bit longer today as we are going to have partly cloudy skies and a high of around 46°. By mid day, it should be skiing really well. If you haven't yet gotten your Chickadee Fever badge on the Snowbird App, now is the time! The Chickadee Lift will close for the 2025-26 season for replacement on April 6th. The new Chickadee Lift is expected to reopen for summer operations in July. ALL uphill travel is closed. Don’t be that guy (or gal). Please remember to ski and ride in control, if you don’t, you’re gonna have a bad time. It's Surf Season, so to quote that one guy, "drop in, just smack the lip, wapow." Go get pitted today. #GMTB
